name: Falling Echo
description: The echo program every 235 ms, the high lever at half so each repeat is 2.5 dB under the last, turned over.

name: Wide Slap
description: The delay program: 80 ms on the left and 120 on the right, each a single repeat, widening a vocal or a guitar.

name: Four Voice Chorus
description: The chorus program's third mode: two delays a side wandering at random, a thick, wide doubling.

name: Lever Phasing
description: The phasing program at 3.2 ms: a short delay against a fixed one, a comb of notches that the lever moves when it is turned or automated.

name: As It Starts
description: The unit as it is switched on: 2.8 seconds, the lows as long as the middle, the highs at half, 40 ms before it. The dense, smooth, dark tail of 1970s and 1980s records, for vocals, strings, and a mix's send.

name: Dark Cathedral
description: The longest time with the lows doubled and the highs at a quarter: a deep, dark tail for pads and slow parts.

name: Endless Space
description: The space program: some ten seconds at every frequency, as bright as the converters allow. A wash under a drone or a pad.

name: Small Room
description: Under a second, the highs at half: a small, dark room around drums or a guitar that does not wash them.

name: Snare Bloom
description: A short, dense burst for a snare: 1.2 seconds with the lows doubled and the highs at a third, no gap.

name: Vocal Tail
description: Two seconds with the highs open to the converters' edge and 20 ms before it, so a voice stays in front of its tail.
